entities.summary: Hryhoriy "Hrytsko" Chubay was a poet, translator and one of the central figures of Ukrainian underground culture under the Soviet rule. His main work is a collection of poems known as Pentateuch (Пʼятикнижжя). Chubay became a victim of government repression due to his participation in samvydav publications.
